eps_bridge_lines: Net effect of restructuring and transaction expenses, tax adjustment and non-controlling interest related to the Faiveley acquisition

items.other_label: restructuring = "restructuring and transaction expenses of $8.9 million related mainly to the Faiveley integration and ongoing cost-reduction activities" (combined; includes any inventory step-up); discrete_tax = $2.1m income tax expense for an adjustment related to the Faiveley acquisition

ngaap.guidance: 2017 (affirmed): revenues about $4.1 billion; adjusted EPS $3.95-$4.15 excluding expected restructuring and transaction expenses and NCI related to Faiveley; quarterly results expected to improve sequentially; Faiveley synergies about $15-20m in 2017, long-term > $50m.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted = GAAP excluding items in the release reconciliation (restructuring/integration, transaction, contract adjustments, discrete tax items, NCI adj.). No reconciliation table in the Q1-17 release. Narrative only: restructuring/transaction $8.9m, $2.1m Faiveley tax adjustment, NCI; net EPS effect -7 cents (implied adjusted EPS ~0.84, not published as a figure).
